problem:
The position vector $r$ of a particle $P$ (relative to a fixed origin $O$) at time $t$ is given by

$$
r=⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡(2t+1),\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(t+1)⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the speed $|v|$ of the particle at time $t=1.$ Do not round the answer.

The speed at time $t=1$ is
{{field-1}}.
worked_solution:
First, we calculate the velocity vector $v.$ Differentiating the position vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =\frac{\text{d}r}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}t},\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(2t+1)),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(t+1))⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{2}{2t+1},\,\frac{1}{t+1}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

To find the velocity when $t=1,$ we substitute in the above:

$$
\begin{aligned}v(1) & =⟨\frac{2}{2(1)+1},\,\frac{1}{1+1}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{2}{3},\,\frac{1}{2}⟩\end{aligned}
$$

To find the speed at $t=1$ we calculate the magnitude of $v(1),$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|v(1)| & =\sqrt{{(\frac{2}{3})}^{2}+{(\frac{1}{2})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{4}{9}+\frac{1}{4}} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{25}{36}} \\  & =\frac{5}{6}.\end{aligned}
$$
